title: Walmart GTA 6 Pre-Orders Will Include A ‘Surprise’ - Kotaku
summary: Give me a 10-inch statue of Jason, then we’ll talk
text: Walmart GTA 6 Pre-Orders Will Include A ‘Surprise’ - Kotaku Skip to content Kotaku Latest Entertainment Reviews News Tips & Guides Games Downloads Deals News Walmart GTA 6 Pre-Orders Will Include A ‘Surprise’ Give me a 10-inch statue of Jason, then we’ll talk Grand Theft Auto 6 By Kenneth Shepard Published November 2, 2026 | Comments ( 12 ) | 𝕏 Copied! © Rockstar Pre-ordering a physical copy of Grand Theft Auto 6 probably feels kind of pointless to most people considering it’s not launching with an actual disc , and even if you buy the box with a code inside, you’ll still have to download all 210 GB to your hard drive to play it. It makes sense, then, that some physical retailers might add some kind of incentive in an effort to get people to actually buy the game from them, and in Walmart’s case, that included incentive is…a surprise! Walmart has pre-orders up for GTA 6 on its website , and while the page has seemingly been edited since, deals-tracking account Nintendeals managed to get a photo of text on the store page that previously mentioned a “pre-order bonus” for buying the game from the retail giant. Grand Theft Auto VI pre-orders from Walmart will have a "surprise" included with the delivery PS5: https://t.co/rg1UXrdlNv Xbox: https://t.co/O5uIsoNGwx #ad pic.twitter.com/DlwHKBmlwE - Nintendeal (@Nintendeal) November 2, 2026 There are no descriptors for the contents of the “surprise and delight bag,” as it’s called, which has fans speculating that it may be similar to the Pringles and Coke goodie packages Walmart sent out to people who pre-ordered the Switch 2 last year. I don’t know about y’all, but I order a whole pizza when I start playing a new game. I don’t think a can of Pringles is gonna cut it, personally. It’s certainly not enough to get me to buy a digital code in a box. I’d also warn would-be buyers tempted by this offer that Walmart has been having some trouble fulfilling its pre-orders this past week. In this case, however, if for whatever reason Walmart doesn’t get enough “physical” copies of GTA 6 to fulfill preorders, you can just go download the game on the PlayStation or Xbox store. Whatever “surprise” Walmart ends up shipping out with GTA 6 copies, if you’re looking for actual physical memorabilia to go with the game, Rockstar is releasing a $400 box of stuff that, crucially, doesn’t include the $80 video game. For that much money, I’d better be getting a high-quality, sculpted statue of Jason and Lucia . Instead, there’s an alligator mascot from an in-game TV show. 🕹️ Level up your inbox Don’t miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter.
